name: steward
description: Steward is a role-based engineering team plugin: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes work into a task DAG with file ownership, and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents. The current release covers feature delivery; bug fixing, maintenance, and takeover are on the roadmap.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Steward（长期维护型研发团队）：主代理作为 Tech Lead，把需求拆成任务 DAG，按依赖与文件所有权调度 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员与代码评审员。当前版本覆盖功能交付；Bug 修复、维护循环、接手存量项目见路线图。

The current release covers feature delivery; bug fixing, maintenance, and takeover are on the roadmap.
